title: Japan Ku-area of Tokyo CPI (February 2027, preliminary), 08:30 JST
source: EST: stat.go.jp/english/data/cpi/1582.html ('Consumer Price Index — Schedule of Release', page's own 'Last Update : 23 January 2026'), re-fetched raw direct 2026-09-05 (HTTP 200, 13,839 bytes) and parsed cell-by-cell out of its single 17-row HTML table by this session. Against the header 'Japan: Survey month | Date of release || Ku-area of Tokyo (preliminary): Survey month | Date of release || Remarks', the second-to-last row parses exactly as ['January, 2027', 'February 19', 'February', 'February 26', ''] — i.e. the Tokyo February-2027 preliminary CPI releases 2027-02-26. 2027-02-26 is a Friday and is clear of Japanese public holidays per the Cabinet Office's own list (www8.cao.go.jp/chosei/shukujitsu/syukujitsu.csv, HTTP 200, 21,538 bytes, Shift-JIS, fetched by this session the same day; the nearest 2027 holidays are 2027-02-11 and 2027-02-23). Filed estimate on three counts, identical to its sibling rows: the confirmed-prefix taxonomy has BLS:/BEA:/CENSUS: for US statistical agencies and no slot for Japan's Statistics Bureau, this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep, and the schedule page's own last-update stamp is 2026-01-23. The 08:30 JST release time is the Statistics Bureau's standing convention and is NOT read off this page — treat it as the weaker half of this entry
notes: DISCOVERED during the japan-cpi-2027-03-19 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-05). Tracked for two reasons, and the second is the interesting one. (1) It is the LAST JAPANESE PRICE READING OF ANY KIND before the Bank of Japan's 2027-03-18 decision (boj-decision-2027-03-18, estimate) — 20 days ahead of it — and the conventional lead indicator for the national February print that lands one day after that decision (japan-cpi-2027-03-19, estimate). (2) It is the INSTRUMENT OF A REGISTERED FORWARD TEST THAT EXPECTS IT TO UNDERPERFORM. The japan-cpi-2027-01-22 ledger measured the Tokyo-minus-national same-month core gap at 0.201pp mean absolute over 2018-2026 and concluded a national print is '~80% pre-published' by its flash. The japan-cpi-2027-03-19 session replicated that arithmetic exactly and then benchmarked it against simply repeating the previous national print (japan-cpi-2027-02-19, estimate, released a week EARLIER and therefore always available): over 319 months from 2000-01 the Tokyo flash wins only 36% of head-to-heads (mean absolute error 0.250pp vs 0.182pp), and over 27 Februaries only 33% (0.288pp vs 0.178pp). Its edge exists only inside the 2018+ window the sibling measured, and even there it is a coin flip at 52%. FT-japan-cpi-2027-03-19-1 registers the strict inequality — this flash lands NO CLOSER to the 2027-03-19 national February core print than the 2027-02-19 national January print does — scored 2027-03-20. Impact is LOW: no house playbook is keyed to Japanese prices, symbols is empty, and the value is calibration rather than a price channel.
